fields.Name: Diagnostics: Run Sessions
fields.Description: Grants permission to start and stop diagnostic recording sessions, build local .mjdiag bundles, preview bundle findings, and download bundles.

fields.Name: Diagnostics: Send Externally
fields.Description: Grants permission to transmit encrypted diagnostic bundles externally to MemberJunction Central (MJC) or a configured CustomerCollector when external sharing is enabled.

fields.Name: Diagnostics: Manage Intake
fields.Description: Grants permission to manage this collector's diagnostic intake: issue one-time sender registration codes, and enrol this installation as a sender with a collector.
